methodology: Queue includes only generated, unreviewed, non-Scripture documents under data/corpus for de/es/hi/sq/th. It does not modify or publish source text. contentSignature is the canonical repository signature of each document and is a batch identity, not a review approval. German/Spanish/Hindi/Albanian counts use a Unicode-letter approximation; Thai counts use thAdapter ICU/compound word tokens and also report analyzed token counts.
reviewerChecklist: Read every target-language sentence against the source file.
Check spelling, orthography, agreement, word choice, idiom and naturalness for the intended variety.
Check that the English gloss is faithful, without using it to rewrite the target text.
Record the result with scripts/corpus-review.mts --by "<reviewer>" --level native; use linguistic-check only for a non-native language check.
Keep machine-drafted and generated labels until a real review is recorded; do not claim native review in advance.
